_note: ev_01 is the example record from docs/ai/DATA.md section 4 (its payload is extended with title, body, tool, code, table and chart for the Report screen, ROADMAP 2.7). The rest are INVENTED PLACEHOLDERS (run, step and payload values). Payload keys read by the Report screen: title, body, tool, code, table {headers, rows}, quote, and for the chart `chart` {title, unit, series[{label, value, photo_value}]} on the D1 table record. The chart numbers are computed in code, never by the model. type `critic_note` is new (a flagged claim's 'why'). Evidence for r_04 (the partial run) has no R1 record: Hound found no passage. Prose is example text in English. Records of r_01 and r_04 carry a `ko` object in the payload with the Korean title, body, table and chart text (ROADMAP 2.7b); quote and code are never translated.
